plan.scope: Fixed static JavaScript transfers only. No ad requests, impressions, clicks, redirects or retries. Native protected client path; not Android SDK load/show latency.
plan.hypothesis: Bias one locally alive fast choice using repeated full AdsJS completion evidence, while retaining all endpoints and native fail-closed recovery. Static costs are experimental and can age; no automatic learning or global quarantine is claimed.
plan.score_rule: 3/3 completion -> 0.25; 2/3 -> 1; 1/3 -> 2; 0/3 -> 4. Frozen before baseline and trial.
